message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded Chinese restaurants across Manhattan (and one on Long Island) that consistently receive rave reviews:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|-------------|
| **Jiang** | Midtown East – 5th Ave & 33rd St | Contemporary Cantonese dishes, elegant setting, excellent dim‑sum during lunch hours. |
| **Hwa Yuan** | Upper West Side – 10th Ave & Waverly Pl | Classic Sichuan cuisine, famous spicy hot pot, cozy atmosphere. |
| **Shinji** | Brooklyn Heights – Flatbush Ave | Authentic Shanghainese dumplings (“xiao long bao”), great service, casual vibe. |
| **Mao’s Kitchen** | Lower East Side – Canal St | Traditional Hunan flavors, generous portions, popular among locals. |
| **Sichuan House** | Queens – Astoria Blvd | Known for its fiery mapo tofu and hand‑made noodles, friendly staff. |

If you're looking for something more upscale:
* **Lung King Heen** at Mandarin Oriental (Midtown) offers Michelin‑starred Cantonese fare—great if you want an exceptional dining experience.

All of these places have solid reputations for quality food and attentive service. Enjoy your meal!
